YKuX13W72jU.text: What is ShelfView? ShelfView is Scandit's AI shelf intelligence solution. It detects out-of-stocks, planogram inconsistencies, and pricing errors, then gives associates prioritized, step-by-step actions to fix them and increase on-shelf availability. It uses Hybrid Data Capture, combining mobile devices, fixed cameras, and robots, and delivers 99.7% shelf insight accuracy that adapts to any store, size, and shelf. More: https://www.scandit.com/products/shelfview/
